changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDiagramAssetField') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDiagramAssetField]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [FieldValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [FormattedValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NULL, [LookupValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Object] [nvarchar](50) NULL, [ObjectId] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionDiagramAssetField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionItemUid] DESC, [ExecutionID] DESC, [FieldName] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] TEXTIMAGE_ON [PRIMARY] END
